I still think the answer is Amr Moussa, who was Arab League Secretary-General from 2001 to 2011, but this search did not confirm it. I found no source linking an Arab Creativity Union in Egypt, Mishary Alafasy, or any Arab League Secretary-General to a first "Arab Creativity Oscar." The earlier EverybodyWiki and Barakah Insider snippets I relied on were not reopened, so treat the answer as unverified.
